intro: Warsong Scout Update is a Horde communication task connecting the outpost commanders along the borders of Ashenvale with forward scouts watching the contested forest. Carrying strategic orders from Kadrak, couriers ensure the Warsong Clan maintains tight surveillance against ambushing night elves. It highlights the tenuous, hostile grip the Horde strives to maintain over their newly claimed territory.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Keep an eye out, traveler. The elves are often hiding in the shadows...
We must always be watching. We have worked very hard to claim this land, and the elves are looking for a chance to take it from us.
I assume you have my next orders from Kadrak?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Let Kadrak know of the success we have had here holding off the night elves. Our plans are going well.
